messages:
Maya - Partnerships: Heads up — partner QA reported sporadic OOMs on A100 when running our inference smoke with CUDA 12.2 + NVIDIA driver 535.xx. We should scrub marketplace AMIs/containers and decide on gating/pinning before the joint announcement next week. See partner report: https://redwood-internal/partners/INC-1234 :eyes:
Liam - Eng Infra: Thanks — do we have a minimal repro or logs? I can spin up a repro harness on a dedicated A100 and run the same batch/seq settings.
Sophia - Runtime: I repro'd locally on the perf harness. Repro steps: batch=8, seq_len=2048, model=gpt-medium-ish. Observed a KV cache memory bump that doesn't free between requests; looks like a driver-side allocation/regression.
Diego - Marketplace: We had 535 pinned in the latest marketplace image notes. If we move back to 530.x will that break any of our optimized kernels or tests? Partner is asking whether the marketplace image is safe to use for tomorrow's partner demo.
Liam - Eng Infra: 530.41 was stable in our last round, but we do lose a small perf win on multi-gpu NCCL kernels. That might be acceptable for the demo. Proposal: temporarily pin marketplace artifacts to 530.41 and gate 535 on a hotfix from vendor.
Maya - Partnerships: Agreed on temporary pin. @Diego can you block the announcement and update the partner comms draft? We should be explicit: delaying broad rollout of 535 until validation completes.
Diego - Marketplace: On it. I'll mark the marketplace release as "hold" and update the release notes. Also will add warning to the onboarding doc.
OpsBot: test-run created: T-456 - infra: a100-repro / job started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/test/T-456
Sophia - Runtime: Quick matrix I ran locally (pasted):
```
Hardware | Driver | CUDA | Status
A100 (SXM) | 530.41 | 12.1 | PASS (smoke + perf)
A100 (SXM) | 535.86 | 12.2 | FAIL (OOM after ~60 steps)
H100 | 535.86 | 12.2 | PASS
V100 | 530.41 | 11.4 | PASS
```
Liam - Eng Infra: Good matrix. Action items: 1) pin marketplace images to 530.41 (Diego) 2) infra runs extended canary on A100 with both drivers (Liam) 3) runtime adds a memory regression test to nightly (Sophia) 4) partnerships coordinates partner comms (Maya).
Maya - Partnerships: I'll draft the partner note: "We detected a driver regression impacting A100; we've pinned our public images and paused the 535 rollout while we validate the vendor hotfix." Will share copy for sign-off.
Diego - Marketplace: ETA for blocking marketplace listing: 30m. I'll also add a manual override for partners who want to opt into 535 with a big-warning.
Liam - Eng Infra: I'll run the canary matrix now. If we see the same OOM, next step is to open vendor escalation and get 535.x hotfix candidate.
Sophia - Runtime: If vendor provides 535.2/535.3 we need to run our quality gates: 1) perf within 5% on our critical traces, 2) no memory leaks over 10k tokens, 3) no regression on 99th latency.
Maya - Partnerships: Partner asked if we can snapshot logs for their internal team — I'll obtain permission and share sanitized logs. Also want to confirm: do we want to delay the joint announcement until gating passes, or proceed with a narrower statement?
Diego - Marketplace: Prefer to delay broad announcement. We can still run the demo with pinned image + explicit note.
Liam - Eng Infra: Agreed. I'll escalate to vendor now if canary reproduces. Vendor contact on file: drv-bug@vendor.example.com, cc: eng-infra.
Sophia - Runtime: Quick note — if we do rollback to 530.41, we should run a quick perf-tune pass to re-evaluate batch sizes for cost targets. I'll add that to the runtime checklist.
Maya - Partnerships: OK — final check. Who's owning sign-off once vendor provides hotfix?
Liam - Eng Infra: Infra owns validation + sign-off on driver gating. I'll post results to this thread and update the release ticket.
Diego - Marketplace: I'll keep marketplace on hold and update partner-facing docs.
Sophia - Runtime: I'll run the nightly memory regression and attach traces.
Maya - Partnerships: Thanks all. I'll hold the announcement draft until Liam posts green. :thumbsup:
Diego - Marketplace: Block in place — marking release notes "held - driver pin to 530.41" :lock:
OpsBot: T-456 finished — canary logs uploaded (pass/fail summary): A100 with 535 = FAIL, A100 with 530 = PASS. https://ci.redwood/test/T-456/logs
Liam - Eng Infra: Confirmed failure on 535 in CI. Opening vendor escalation ticket now and attaching CI artifacts: https://redwood-internal/bugs/BR-789.
Maya - Partnerships: I'll notify partner PMs and legal about the hold. Thanks everyone.
Diego - Marketplace: Once vendor gives green, I'll rotate marketplace images and post a small heads-up. Otherwise we'll keep pinned until patch is validated. :white_check_mark:
